name: Sensor & Mic Hardware Firewall
description: Zero-touch server-shipped module that blanks camera/microphone buffers, zeroes gyroscope/accelerometer telemetry, and blocks background ultrasonic beacons.

features.title: Silent PCM Microphone Guard
features.description: Injects zeroed PCM audio frames into AudioRecord when background apps attempt covert recording.

features.title: Camera2 Black Frame Shield
features.description: Replaces CameraDevice capture surfaces with synthetic blank frames unless explicitly whitelisted.

features.title: Gyroscope & Step Counter Scrubber
features.description: Prevents gait and micro-vibration fingerprinting across SensorManager listeners.
